problem: The file is opened in write mode, which truncates it and makes json.load fail, instead of read mode.
The loop range stops at len(items) - 1, so the last item is left out of the total.
The mutable default argument tags=[] is shared across calls, so tags accumulate instead of starting empty each call.
The comparison uses > instead of >=, so an item with exactly qty in stock is wrongly reported as unable to fulfil.
The discount divides by 10 instead of 100, so the percent is applied ten times too large.
The comparison uses > instead of <, so it returns items above their reorder level rather than below it.
Using 'or 1' turns a quantity of 0 (cancelled order) into 1, instead of only defaulting when qty is missing.
